name: Glowing title, swoosh underline
what: A glowing title and subtitle rise from below the frame, overshoot a little and settle; then a hot dot lights up at the left and a hand-drawn swoosh underline is drawn under them, left to right, ending in a small hook.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f19 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:19) the title rises from below the frame, overshoots its place by about 100 px at f10 (00:00:00:10) and settles; the subtitle does the same 2 frames later (f2-f20); f11-f30 (00:00:00:11-00:00:01:00) a hot dot lights up at the left and grows into a swoosh drawn left to right, accelerating until f24 then decelerating, fat and bright at birth and thinning; f30-f44 everything holds
